title: 1 Day Fasting for Ramadan I 2026 version
description:
Hello everyone! I hope you're all doing well.

It's been AGES since I last uploaded anything on this Produsorn, and I swear to god I did not forget the password to my account!!! Life just got really hectic, and I got carried away with other things.

I had the opportunity to fast for one day in support of the Muslim community during Ramadan, and I'm finally uploading the video! I know I'm already a couple of months late, but it was such an honor to show my support and love to all the Muslim fans out there by participating in Ramadan this year.

I hope you enjoy watching it! ❤️
